snippet.title: Brawl Meta Knight Returns | SSBU Mod Showcase (Director's Cut)
snippet.description:
Well, well, well... This is really happening. Brawl Meta Knight is making a comeback Ultimate! Not only will he have the moveset but also his mechanics from Brawl!

This is the UNCUT version of the Brawl Meta Knight segment that was featured in the SSBU Modding Direct on 64ios's channel https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IclsSxh5p0g

Mod Download:
https://gamebanana.com/mods/477036
